best_time.quote: If you're coming by car, we recommend avoiding travel between 9 a.m. and 12 p.m., as there may be a higher volume of visitors during that time.
best_time.note: Method: the valley office advises against arriving 09:00-12:00 for crowds; early morning and late afternoon are the times outside that peak. The office states no positive best time.

v.fallback: In the summer regulation, cars may enter the valley 09:00-16:00 only with an online permit (the combined ticket includes guaranteed parking); online booking opens in early June on prags.bz. Before 09:00 entry is allowed but parking is not guaranteed. Buses 439 and 442 must be booked and paid online.

window.quote: access to the Pragser Tal valley between 9:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. is only permitted by public transportation, on foot, by bicycle or upon presentation of an online reservation
window.note: Release date within June and the time of day are not published; the regulation is announced to return in summer 2027 with details in spring.
